text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having opted out of running in the 
Japanese Derby, Kitasan Black witnessed 
Brusqueman seize victory with a new Derby 
record.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that explosive final burst of speed 
firsthand, Kitasan Black realized the 
terror of mid-to-long distance races—where 
running out of steam meant getting 
overtaken in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she lacks long-distance aptitude, the 
3,000m autumn Kikuka Sho will be rough. A 
new worry had begun to surface.
